解析:
若秩 $r(A) = n$ ，则 $|A| \neq 0$ ，由于 $AA^{*} = |A|E$ ，故 $|A^{*}| \neq 0$ ，所以秩 $r(A^{*}) = \dot{n}$ .

若秩 $r(A) < n - 1$ ，则 $\mathbf{A}$ 中所有 $n - 1$ 阶子式均为0，即行列式 $|\mathbf{A}|$ 的所有代数余子式均为0，即 $\mathbf{A}^{*} = \mathbf{O}$ ，故 $r(\mathbf{A}^{*}) = 0$ 。

若秩 $r(A) = n - 1$ ，则 $\left|A\right| = 0$ 且 $\mathbf{A}$ 中存在 $n - 1$ 阶子式不为0.那么，由 $\left|\mathbf{A}\right| = 0$ 有

$$
\mathbf {A} \mathbf {A} ^ {*} = | \mathbf {A} | \mathbf {E} = \mathbf {O},
$$

从而 $r(\mathbf{A}) + r(\mathbf{A}^{*})\leqslant n$ ，得 $r(\mathbf{A}^{*})\leqslant 1.$ 

又因 $\pmb{A}$ 中有 $n - 1$ 阶子式非0，知有 $A_{ij} \neq 0$ ，即 $\mathbf{A}^{*} \neq \mathbf{O}$ ，得 $r(\mathbf{A}^{*}) \geqslant 1$ ，故 $r(\mathbf{A}^{*}) = 1$ .

题目内容: 【例2.26】设 $A$, $B$ 均为 $n$ 阶矩阵. 如果 $E-AB$ 可逆, 证明 $E-BA$ 可逆.
解析:
因

$$
\left[ \begin{array}{l l} {\pmb {E}} & {\pmb {O}} \\ {- \pmb {A}} & {\pmb {E}} \end{array} \right] \left[ \begin{array}{l l} {\pmb {E}} & {\pmb {B}} \\ {\pmb {A}} & {\pmb {E}} \end{array} \right] = \left[ \begin{array}{l l} {\pmb {E}} & {\pmb {B}} \\ {\pmb {O}} & {\pmb {E} - \pmb {A B}} \end{array} \right],
$$

$$
\left| \begin{array}{c c} {\pmb {E}} & {\pmb {O}} \\ {- \pmb {A}} & {\pmb {E}} \end{array} \right| \cdot \left| \begin{array}{c c} {\pmb {E}} & {\pmb {B}} \\ {\pmb {A}} & {\pmb {E}} \end{array} \right| = \left| \begin{array}{c c} {\pmb {E}} & {\pmb {B}} \\ {\pmb {O}} & {\pmb {E} - \pmb {A B}} \end{array} \right|,
$$

有

$$
\left| \begin{array}{c c} \boldsymbol {E} & \boldsymbol {B} \\ \boldsymbol {A} & \boldsymbol {E} \end{array} \right| = | \boldsymbol {E} - \boldsymbol {A B} |.
$$

又

$$
\left[ \begin{array}{c c} {\pmb {E}} & {\pmb {B}} \\ {\pmb {A}} & {\pmb {E}} \end{array} \right] \left[ \begin{array}{c c} {\pmb {E}} & {\pmb {O}} \\ {- \pmb {A}} & {\pmb {E}} \end{array} \right] = \left[ \begin{array}{c c} {\pmb {E} - \pmb {B A}} & {\pmb {B}} \\ {\pmb {O}} & {\pmb {E}} \end{array} \right],
$$

得

$$
\left| \begin{array}{c c} {\pmb {E}} & {\pmb {B}} \\ {\pmb {A}} & {\pmb {E}} \end{array} \right| = | \pmb {E} - \pmb {B A} |.
$$

所以 $|\mathbf{E} - \mathbf{AB}| = |\mathbf{E} - \mathbf{BA}|$ .

因而， $E - BA$ 可逆.

或反证法：

如果 $|\mathbf{E} - \mathbf{BA}| = 0$ ，则 $(\mathbf{E} - \mathbf{BA})\mathbf{x} = \mathbf{0}$ 有非零解.

设 $\pmb{\alpha} \neq \mathbf{0}, (\pmb{E} - \pmb{B}\pmb{A})\pmb{\alpha} = \mathbf{0}$ , 于是 $BA\pmb{\alpha} = \pmb{\alpha} \neq \mathbf{0}$ , 而且 $A\pmb{\alpha} \neq \mathbf{0}$ , 那么

$$
(E - A B) A \alpha = A \alpha - A B A \alpha = A \alpha - A \alpha = 0.
$$

从而 $A\alpha$ 是 $(E-AB)x=0$ 的非零解与 E-AB 可逆相矛盾.
因而，E-BA 可逆.

题目内容: 【例2.29】$n$ 阶矩阵 $\mathbf{A} = \begin{bmatrix} a & 1 & 1 & \cdots & 1\\ 1 & a & 1 & \cdots & 1\\ 1 & 1 & a & \cdots & 1\\ \vdots & \vdots & \vdots & & \vdots \\ 1 & 1 & 1 & \cdots & a \end{bmatrix}$ 的秩 $=$ ____.
解析:
（方法一） 经初等变换矩阵的秩不变.

$$
\mathbf {A} = \left[\begin{array}{c c c c c}a&1&1&\dots&1\\1&a&1&\dots&1\\1&1&a&\dots&1\\\vdots&\vdots&\vdots&&\vdots\\1&1&1&\dots&a\end{array}\right]\rightarrow \left[\begin{array}{c c c c c}a&1&1&\dots&1\\1 - a&a - 1&0&\dots&0\\1 - a&0&a - 1&\dots&0\\\vdots&\vdots&\vdots&&\vdots\\1 - a&0&0&\dots&a - 1\end{array}\right]
$$

$$
\rightarrow \left[\begin{array}{c c c c c}a + n - 1&1&1&\dots&1\\0&a - 1&0&\dots&0\\0&0&a - 1&\dots&0\\\vdots&\vdots&\vdots&&\vdots\\0&0&0&\dots&a - 1\end{array}\right].
$$

若 $a \neq 1$ 且 $a \neq 1 - n$ , 则 $r(A) = n$ .

若 $a = 1$ ，则 $r(A) = 1$ 

若 $a = 1 - n$ ，则 $r(A) = n - 1.$ 

(方法二) 用行列式.
$$
| \mathbf {A} | = \left| \begin{array}{c c c c c} a & 1 & 1 & \dots & 1 \\ 1 & a & 1 & \dots & 1 \\ 1 & 1 & a & \dots & 1 \\ \vdots & \vdots & \vdots & & \vdots \\ 1 & 1 & 1 & \dots & a \end{array} \right| = (a + n - 1) (a - 1) ^ {n - 1}.
$$

若 $a \neq 1$ 且 $a \neq 1 - n$ , 则 $|\mathbf{A}| \neq 0$ , 故 $r(\mathbf{A}) = n$ .

若 a = 1，易见 $r(A) = 1$ .

若 $a = 1 - n$ ，知 $n - 1$ 阶子式

$$
A _ {1 1} = \left| \begin{array}{c c c c} a & 1 & \dots & 1 \\ 1 & a & \dots & 1 \\ \vdots & \vdots & & \vdots \\ 1 & 1 & \dots & a \end{array} \right| = (a + n - 2) (a - 1) ^ {n - 2} \neq 0, | \mathbf {A} | = 0,
$$

故 $r(A)=n-1$ .

(方法三) 用相似.

因为 $\pmb{A}$ 是实对称矩阵， $\pmb{A} \sim \pmb{\Lambda}$ . 只要求出 $r(\pmb{\Lambda})$ 就知 $r(\pmb{A})$ ，为此由 $\pmb{A}$ 的特征值入手. 因为

$$
\begin{array}{r l} \mathbf {A} & = \left[ \begin{array}{c c c c c} a - 1 & & & & \\ & a - 1 & & & \\ & & a - 1 & & \\ & & & \ddots & \\ & & & & a - 1 \end{array} \right] + \left[ \begin{array}{c c c c c} 1 & 1 & 1 & \dots & 1 \\ 1 & 1 & 1 & \dots & 1 \\ 1 & 1 & 1 & \dots & 1 \\ \vdots & \vdots & \vdots & & \vdots \\ 1 & 1 & 1 & \dots & 1 \end{array} \right] \\ & = (a - 1) \mathbf {E} + \mathbf {B}, \end{array}
$$

而矩阵 $\pmb{B}$ 的秩为1，有

$$
\mid \lambda E - B \mid = \lambda^ {n} - n \lambda^ {n - 1},
$$

得到矩阵 B 的特征值是 $n,0,0,\cdots,0(n-1$ 个 $)$ ，因此矩阵 A 的特征值是 $n+a-1,a-1,a-1,\cdots,a-1$ .

又因 A 是实对称矩阵, 故

$$
\mathbf {A} \sim \mathbf {\Lambda} = \left[ \begin{array}{c c c c} n + a - 1 & & & \\ & a - 1 & & \\ & & \ddots & \\ & & & a - 1 \end{array} \right],
$$

那么

$$
r (\mathbf {A}) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} n, & \text {若} a \neq 1 \text {且} a \neq 1 - n, \\ n - 1, & \text {若} a = 1 - n, \\ 1, & \text {若} a = 1. \end{array} \right.
$$
